transparent · opt-in · stoppable
A small favor for a Quantus miner

Lend ten minutes of hash.

If you have an idle computer, you can voluntarily point a little CPU or GPU work at this Quantus address. You stay in control: nothing starts automatically, and closing the miner stops it.

Mining uses electricity and creates heat. Only use a device you own or are authorized to use.

Choose how you help.

The browser route is easy and modest. The native CUDA route is much faster on an NVIDIA GPU, but requires a download and should only be used by experienced volunteers.

Easy · browser

Click, paste, start

Copies the destination address and opens the official browser miner. Paste it, choose CPU or WebGPU, set a comfortable intensity, and press Start.

Fast · NVIDIA CUDA

Run the native miner

For RTX hardware. Use the pool’s official setup page, verify its published checksum, then replace the worker name with something recognizable.

./qpow-cuda-linux-x86_64 pool ws://quantusminer.com:9901 qzq2E9QiGfz9q7mbtNA8uWdb8VGApRSY659zprMLUj9FAPZ4Z volunteer-rig

What happens to the work?

01 / CONNECT

Your miner joins the pool

Only a public payout address and worker name are sent. No wallet key is needed.

02 / PROVE

Valid shares are counted

The pool verifies submitted QPoW shares and includes them in its public worker totals.

03 / CREDIT

Rewards go to the address

Pool rewards earned by contributed work are credited to the destination shown below.

qzq2E9QiGfz9q7mbtNA8uWdb8VGApRSY659zprMLUj9FAPZ4Z
Plain terms

No hidden miner.

This page recruits willing contributors. It does not run mining code itself.

  • CONTROL You must deliberately start the miner; you can stop whenever you want.
  • COST Your device uses power, makes heat, and may run fans loudly.
  • OUTPUT Browser mining is convenient but usually much slower than a native CUDA miner.
  • VERIFY Pool activity is public. Open the live pool page ↗
